en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an inner castle courtyard lined with multi‑storey buildings with steep gabled roofs and small windows. Ivy climbs the facades on the right; at the back a round tower and another high building with a pointed roof and finial rise above the courtyard. Two small figures walk along the path in the middle distance. Printed text at the top left identifies the scene.
